The approved Day 2 route is built: 60 minutes for difference-in-differences,
60 for regression discontinuity and 75 for matching. Participants read one
report extract, make a provisional judgement and ask a useful evaluator question
in each session. The explanation is shorter; guided practice takes most of the time.

| Session | Content screens | Deck | Participant sheet | Trainer pack |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Read the extra change | 10 | [Open](Oct13_session1.html) | [Two sides](Oct13_session1_handouts.docx) | [Key](Oct13_session1_materials.docx) |
| Read the jump at a score rule | 10 | [Open](Oct13_session2_live.html) | [Two sides](Oct13_session2_handouts.docx) | [Eight cards and key](Oct13_session2_materials.docx) |
| Read a matched comparison | 13 | [Open](Oct13_session3.html) | [Two sides](Oct13_session3_handouts.docx) | [Profiles, cost slips and key](Oct13_session3_materials.docx) |

Counts exclude the title. Matching includes a five-minute break. Each session
has one short trainer-run calculation, with a prediction first. Participants
read its result and do not write or debug code.

## Activities and reveals

Fiona's four-number DiD task, eight different RDD cards A to H and
[A1 number line](Oct13_session2_board_A1.pdf) remain. The seven matching
profiles retain their identifiers and characteristics. Costs are separate slips,
held until pairs have been chosen. The optional walking activity remains.

Try the trend-picture feedback, wider RDD window, manager-age check and matching
result with age left out. Commit to a prediction before revealing evidence.
The AI examples are authored drafts for checking against the source, rather
than reported live AI responses. No AI account is required.

Native choices record one open page's choice. For room totals, use the
[course-owned room tool](GreenWaste_room_poll.zip) and its
[classroom instructions](ROOM_POLL_README.md). It hides totals until voting
closes and includes Before/After phases and anonymous reasons. Phone access
still needs a classroom Wi-Fi test; labelled cards are the fallback.

## Corrected figures and print checks

Exactly eight city records at displayed score 58 now take part, as the rule
states. Only their participation, later cost and later landfill values changed.
The pilot is unchanged. Day 1 figures and packs were refreshed.

The DiD estimate is now -812 AED. The local RDD estimate is -721 AED, with a
robust 95% interval of -943 to -498. Matching gives -1,029 AED, with a reported
interval of -1,200 to -859. Screen and paper read the same computed objects.
The RDD correction is larger than the city-wide change because those eight
records sit exactly at the cut-off.

Every participant sheet is two A4 pages. Trainer packs have 3, 12 and 12 pages;
the longer packs contain the group cards and profiles, not twelve pages for
each participant. Word rendered every print page for inspection. The exercise
brief is updated for Days 1 and 2: [open the brief](Module2_exercise_plan_v3.docx).
Later-day rows remain historical pending their rebuild. The [optional case reference](GreenWaste_case_brief.docx) also has corrected counts and recorded means; use it once cost reading has begun.

The decks were checked sequentially at presentation size, including trainer
outputs, evidence reveals and feedback. The data correction and the intended
robust RDD interval are recorded in the source handoff.
